description.value:
You deploy sentry turrets to attack intruders. For each action you spend Casting the Spell, you deploy a sentry turret into an empty space within range, attaching itself to any solid surface. These sentry turrets are Small and visibly dangerous. They have AC 10, Hardness 3, and 15 Hit Points and are immune to critical hits and precision damage. The sentries also have the tech trait. Whenever a visible creature that isn't Avoiding Notice, Hiding, or Sneaking comes within 15 feet of a sentry turret, you receive a ping and a small video feed of the creature on your comm unit. Once per round on subsequent turns, you can Interact with your comm unit to Command any number of sentry turrets to each fire a beam of energy at a creature within 30 feet of the sentry turret, dealing 2d6 fire damage (basic Reflex save). A creature can only be targeted by a single sentry turret each turn, even if it's within range of multiple sentries.

Heightened (+2) The Hit Points of each sentry turret increase by 10, and the damage increases by 1d6.
